docs.title: Intro
docs.text: Updated as of Notoriety version 3.19a

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Rotations are the fastest ways of getting infamies in Notoriety, and this guide will show you how to do them.

You will first be shown the SSD rotation, which will let you reach the cash goal required to infamy along with level 100 in roughly 20-25 minutes, along with the NCDR rotation which lets you get to level 100 as fast as possible without focusing on cash. Takes roughly 10 minutes.

IMPORTANT: The guide's goal is teaching you the loadout, skills, and what each player is supposed to do on each heist, however, complementing the guide with video guides, VOD's, and other resource materials is greatly recommended (which you can find in the 'SSD/NCDR - Resources' tab)

For instructions on how to navigate the guide, check the first question in the FAQ tab

The first thing you should do is join the Moonstone game's group, as that gives a permanent +15% xp and cash. You can join here: https://www.roblox.com/communities/8918098/Moonstone-Games

You should also turn off safe escape if you're planning to host, as that removes the 3s wait before you can actually escape.

docs.title: Commonly used abbreviations and terms
docs.text:
These will be used throughout the guide and between players, so it's important to know what they mean:

CB -> crowbar KC -> keycard MOLLY -> molotov SW -> second wind (skill in tier 1 of ghost skill tree) 3g/6g -> 3 garages/6 garages (areas in depot) WH -> warehouse (the area with crates in shadow raid)\

DS -> diamond store AG -> art gallery SWEEPOT -> depot sweep (our variation of the sweep) SR -> shadow raid NC -> nightclub RH -> rush hour

Have fun reading, any questions are allowed in the help channel in my server. If you're not in it, here's the link: https://discord.gg/khkwFecZ8D

docs.title: How do I navigate the guide?
docs.text:
• On your left you can see the different tabs, by clicking on a specific tab when you're on it opens up the list of headings, so that you can go wherever you want in a few clicks (example below)

  • You can equally do this on mobile, by clicking the two arrows on the right of your screen (example below)

docs.title: How do I get into rushing?
docs.text:
• By choosing a role (1, 2, 3 or 4) and reading what they do in this guide, you can then apply for the new challenger role in the discord server, which is proof that you understand what your role does. (https://discord.gg/khkwFecZ8D)

  • Once you’ve learnt about the role you chose, go into the guides channel so you can get a reaction role for it.

docs.title: Where do I find people to rush?
docs.text: • Once promoted to new challenger you're eligible to join lobbies in the lobby channel, or host one yourself.

docs.title: How hard is it to rush?
docs.text: • Quite easy once you understand what your role does! The guide might look long, but remember you only need to read about your role, everyone else knows what to do on their role, so the rotations will flow smoothly

docs.title: What are SSD & NCDR?
docs.text: • Those are what we call rotations. SSD is the cash oriented one, NCDR is the xp oriented one, you can check them out yourself in the rotations channel!

docs.title: What are rotations?
docs.text: • They're a series of xp/cash efficient heists to make the best use of repeat bonus in order to reach lvl 100 and or 62.5/125m cash in the shortest time possible.

docs.title: What is ecm rushing?
docs.text: • It is the act of placing down ecm devices one after another, as it prevents NPCs and cameras from raising the alarm. Allowing to complete the objectives of the map as fast as possible without having to worry about being detected.

docs.title: What are pre-skills and skill breaks?
docs.text:
• These are moments where instead of going directly to the next heist, you instead get a bunch of skills, to make the next heists possible/easier.
  • Pre skills refer to getting a few skills, shown in your role section, before you do the first set of heists (before Diamond store for SSD, before Depot for NCDR)
  • Skill breaks refer to getting a bunch of other skills (again, shown in your role section) between heist sets (after Diamond store in SSD, after Depot for NCDR)

docs.title: Do I need to be infamy 25 to rush?
docs.text:
• Whilst obviously recommended, since you'll have max infamy bonuses, you can start at whatever infamy.
  • If you're missing XP bonuses, ask your teammates to do a few jewellery stores before the rotation begins, until you're level 27. So that you can get the pre-skills

docs.title: Do I need any gamepasses to rush?
docs.text: • No. Weapon gamepasses aren't needed at all, and the rotations can be done with an XP or cash booster to replace the gamepass, eliminating any need for them. Although variations of SSD/NCDR for gamepass-owners exist, if you have them.

docs.title: How should the guide look like?
docs.text:
1. Introduction (explanation of what this is, what it will achieve if you read it, about the new challenger app) > FAQ, with the ability to add-on faq that isn't in the last guide > skills and loadouts
  2. SSD, explanation of what it is and its purpose, link to the rotation channel in the server, a heist order
  • Introduction of the heist, starting with the objectives (e.g requires x bags, we sweep...)
  • Role's 1 through 4, at first a bit of explaining on what their job is on the heist, with a video showcase and image per image of their pathing. (here would be included a video tutorial)
  • Then you'd have a link to a page, called role x resources, which includes clips and word+video explanations of variations, like kc swap, like c room first as r4 in ag... this would also include stuff like where you should be throwing your bags, movement tips, adaptation plays, so on so forth

Specification for the roles, is how i explained to hox and kendle that the roles will be split into baggers and securers, or throwers and securers, depending on context. Ideally we will have (on sr) r1 and r2 be the throwers, they should throw into two distinguished piles, with a mention on the concept of splitting up bag weight and pairing heavy with heavy, light with light. R3 and r4 are ideally securers. With a mention to variations for kc swap, and with a mention of how to direct secure (it is very important that it is emphasized that this needs learning and is necessary to good rotations)

The same would go for sweepot and other bag moving heists, like ag and the future gmc

Then will follow the gmc ssd variation, with the same principles (ofc i'll be helping in testing and so on there) and at last ncdr, with an important mention of how its a "backup" rotation and not a main one. If you have ANY questions you are free to ping me in council.

There should be a tab for vods (just for raw runs), whether that's on its own or in the resources tab You are suggested to have an overview of what the role's purpose is on each heist, with a breakdown along with it which would be more resourceful

docs.title: Server Code Callouts
docs.text:
To quickly communicate the server code to r2, we send the server code through text where each symbol has a corresponding letter code. The code will either be sent through roblox chat or the discord lobby thread. You should decide on this with r2 before rotation starts depending on roblox chat restrictions.

Σ = E ｷ = T ◆ = R _ = L ▪ = S ▣ = 2S ◒ = O ◉ = 2O ▸ = A empty = -

The code will be sent in a 3x3 grid, just like it appears in the folder. For example if you found this code

You would type

L-- 2OE- -2O-

The dashes at the end of the line can be ignored so you could also type

L 2OE -2O

However if a line is completely empty, you must send at least 1 dash (unless it is the last line) You can use the following site to practise typing the code https://avivendolius.github.io/Hexcode-Practice-For-Role-1-v1.1/

docs.title: Calling out bags
docs.text:
In Depot all roles are almost guaranteed to get a set amount of bags, that being both r1/r2 getting 2 bags in total from the transport warehouse and r3/r4 getting 3 bags in total from 6g, leaving one bag remaining to reach six in total, we refer to this as an “extra bag”, an extra bag can be obtained by any role, when someone obtains it they will use the “Yes!” callout to signal to the other players that they don’t need to get it anymore, and can continue their pathing normally.

Your job as r2 is to make the “Yes!” callout if either you or r1 obtained an extra bag in transport. Since you have to use the callout in case r1 gets the bag it’s important to pay attention to the ui at the bottom of your screen that tells you if r1 is currently getting a bag.

  1. Mask up and head to the transport warehouse, either following the normal red path, or the slightly faster yellow path using the Coach Gun.

  1. Inside the warehouse, look for and bag the following loot if it spawned, you only need to get two bags in total between you and r1, or 3 if you have to get an extra bag (read information about it above).

  1. Exit the warehouse and head over to the crane, remember to juggle your bags if you are carrying a weapon, as it’s a heavy bag and slows you down.

  1. Head to the escape zone, jump and throw your bags when you are going past the railings, then go into the escape zone.

docs.title: Nightclub
docs.text:
Nightclub is featured on all 3 versions of NCDR

  1. Enter the building, either through the front entrance or jumping onto the balcony using the Coach Gun.

  1. Run past the dance floor and into the back area, then enter the basement and open the safe (route shown below).

  1. Two Variants:

    1. If there is cash in the safe, use the “Yes!” callout, then bag the middle cash stack and the left cash stack, if no one has reached your safe yet by the time you finish bagging both cash stacks, then throw them near the bottom of the stairs for them to pick up and bag the remaining stack.

    2. If there isn’t cash in your safe, read the chat to see who called out “Yes!”; if r1 called it, then go to their safe (manager’s office), if r3 called it and r1 didn’t, then go to r3’s safe (poker room). Bag a cash stack from the safe, if you got there late then grab the bags they threw instead.

  2. Bring your bags to the van, throw them in, and step inside to escape.

docs.title: Rush Hour
docs.text: Rush Hour is featured on “No Booster, No Gamepass” and “Booster/Gamepass” versions of NCDR.

docs.title: Close Van Variant
docs.text:
1. Mask up and run to the right side, then open the fence using your saw (hit the middle iron bar as shown in the gif below).

  2. Enter the tech store from the back door, then go to the office on your left side and open the folder to check if it has the server code.

  3. If you found the server code inside the folder, input it in the keypad. If not, wait for one of your teammates to call it out in the chat (read information about it below) or in the Discord thread, then hack the computer.

  1. Return to the back area of the tech store, head over to the left side and into the butcher store.

  2. Enter the manager room, find and bag the blueprint, then open the safe and grab the package inside.

  3. Return to the server room and wait for the hack to finish, then collect the USB from the computer.

docs.title: Far Van Variant
docs.text:
1. Mask up and run to the tech store, enter from the front entrance and into the office room behind the counter.

  2. Go to the office on the top right of the room and check the folder to see if it has the server code.

  3. If you found the server code inside the folder, input it in the keypad. If not, wait for one of your teammates to call it out in the chat (read information about it below) or in the Discord thread, then hack the computer.

  1. Return to the back area of the tech store, head over to the left side and into the butcher store.

  2. Enter the manager room, find and bag the blueprint, then open the safe and grab the package inside.

  3. Return to the server room and wait for the hack to finish, then collect the USB from the computer.

docs.title: Server Code
docs.text:
We use certain letters to represent all of the symbols in the code, and this way quickly share it through the Roblox chat:

Σ = e ｷ = t ◆ = r _ = l ▪ = s ▣ = 2s ◒ = o ◉ = 2o ▸ = a empty = -

For example: if someone types

--l o-o -2s-

This is the code you have to input:

Note

players may omit training spaces. so 2s-- becomes just 2s

You can use this website to practice entering the server code in the keypad: https://avivendolius.github.io/Hexcode-Practice-For-Role-2-v1.1/

Note

It’s important to know which of your teammates you can chat with in Roblox before starting a rot. This way you will know if they can communicate the code to you through Roblox chat or if they have to send it through the lobby thread and decide what method to use.

Good luck on your application!

It’s heavily recommended that you try practicing your pathing for each heist before doing your first rotation, as well as learning the map layouts if you are very new to the game. If you have any questions you can ask in the help channel in the Discord server.

docs.title: Depot
docs.text:
Depot is featured on all 3 versions of NCDR

  1. Kill the guard in the flat are before the ramp and take his key

  1. Start placing a sentry while moving up the ramp to kill all the stationary guards. Kill the key guard at the top area and take his key. He will spawn on the right but move towards the left during the preplanning screen

  1. Open the two rightmost garages and loot 2 bags. Secure bags by throwing them over this fence

  1. If there have not yet been 3 quickchats called, loot a 3rd bag, quickchat “Yes!” and secure it in the same way, otherwise escape

docs.text:
Warning

Make sure the "VIP PARKING" asset has been bought to ensure the van spawns at the back of the nightclub

  1. Enter the nightclub through the main entrance and navigate to the poker room

  2. Open the safe with an ECM:

Cash

Callout

Quickchat “Yes” to signal to the team that your safe has cash.

  1. Bag two of the cash

Note

Someone should arrive to bag your 3rd cash, but if they are not at your safe by the time you have bagged your two, throw them to the poker room entrance and bag the third aswell.

  1. Move your bags to the van and escape

    Ignore the safe contents and proceed

Callout

Check the chat for "Yes!" quickchats. This means that player has cash

  1. If r4 has cash, go to their office safe and bag 1 cash, or move their bags if they throw any behind them

  2. Otherwise, help r2 move their bags in basement

    Warning

    If r4 is slower than you to his safe, he may still have cash, even though he has not quickchat yet. Make sure to check if he has reached his safe before heading to help r2.

  3. Secure bags into the van and escape

docs.title: Art Gallery (AG)
docs.text:
Art Gallery is featured on the "No Gamepass, No Booster" and "Booster/Gamepass" versions of SSD

Ecm

8 and 30s

  1. At the beginning, mask up, run forward, turn back, boost your teammates, run towards the entrance, and use your molotov at the red circle.

  1. After entering the art gallery, run towards the bottom-right room. While running, place down your ECM when you hit the red circle and slide when you hit the blue circle.

  1. While still placing down your ECM, you will end up at the alarm box which is a colored purple circle (if it's there). Then you will check the paintings' 'sold' stickers, starting from the left and ending on the right (checking clockwise).

  1. When you enter the middle-right room, use your molotov to break the glasses containing loose loot. Afterwards, check the paintings for 'sold' stickers, starting from the left and ending on the right (clockwise).

  1. When you enter the middle room, position yourself to the side of both glass loose loot cases (marked with a pink circle) to break both of them with your Breaker 12G. Then loot the room as shown by the yellow navigation line.

  1. When running towards the entrance through the single door, pull out your weapon to break the glass containing loose loot, then slide to the other two and position yourself as shown by the red circle to break both of them at the same time.

  1. After grabbing the loose loot and breaking through the window to the outside, use your molotov at the red circle (on the outside ground). This way, you can avoid taking damage from the fire while throwing bags towards the van.

  3. bag two pieces of jewelry shown below and escape.

docs.title: Nightclub (NC)
docs.text: Nightclub is featured on the “Booster/Gamepass” and “Booster and Gamepass” versions of SSD

docs.title: IMPORTANT NOTES
docs.text:
• Before beginning this heist you must have TP-82 Sonaz Equipped for your Secondary.
  • You must buy the VIP Parking Asset.
  • First Nightclub loot everything, Second Nightclub loot Money only.
  1. At the beginning, run forward & turn behind to boost your teammates then immediately swap to molotov to give yourself a second wind boost after that swap to your Secondary and make sure it's on Burst Mode.
  1. Make your way to the Car on the street shown below.

  1. Use your Secondary Weapon to enter through the window like shown below.

    How do you perform this jump?

    • To perform this jump you must have your Secondary weapon (TP-82 Sonaz) on Burst Mode, then face the windows on top of the car.
    • To jump further you must shoot the gun and jump at the same exact time. (As you click LMB press Space as well).

  1. After you enter the Manager’s Office through the window, proceed to open your safe with your ECM.

    Make sure to use “Yes” Call-out if your safe contains Money Loot.

    If your safe contains Money Loot, make sure to loot the middle one first then the left. You are still meant to loot the Third Money Loot if another role hasn’t reached your safe to grab it.

  1. THIS PART ONLY APPLIES FOR SECOND NIGHTCLUB, If your safe did not contain Money Loot you must go for either the Office or Basement to help bag or carry the Money Loot.

    If “Yes” Call-out came from the Office, break the windows facing the dancing pit and jump down to make your way to the Office.

If “Yes” Call-out came from the Basement, run towards the door shown below and make your way to the Basement.

  1. After looting, throw the bags into the Escape Van which is parked behind the Nightclub.

docs.title: Shadow Raid (SR)
docs.text:
Shadow Raid is featured on the "No Gamepass, No Booster" and "Booster/Gamepass" versions of SSD.

  1. At the beginning, mask up, shoot your gun, run forward, turn back, boost your teammates, run towards the entrance, and use your molotov at the yellow circle.

  1. Lockpick the red container shown below and loot the containings if they are spawned.

If there's only one of the loot inside, take that loot inside with you. If there's both loot inside, throw them towards the red container closer to the entrance. Do NOT bring two loot bags inside with you.

  1. Time your sentry placement in front of the staircase like shown below.

Hold down the sentry placement right after you enter through the single door.

  1. Loot weapons on the metal shelves if they are spawned.

  1. Loot (Money, Weapon and Bloxy Cola) on the metal shelves if they are spawned.

  1. Throw everything you looted towards the exit door.

  1. To start searching for keys you must check the docks guard first.

    Note

    Key Guards CAN spawn anywhere in the map. For each key you grab call-out "Yes!" by pressing your middle mouse button once (Scroll button). If the keycard was found outside R4 will grab it. If R2 has the second one you will have to switch roles with R4 and continue opening red containers outside.

  1. After both keycards are found, head towards the vault and only loot the top parts of the armor.

If R2 is not there to help you with the vault, you will have to loot the bottom parts as well. If you are to loot both top and bottom parts of the armor, you'll have to throw 2 bags outside to the yellow circle spot shown below.

  1. After looting the vault, carry all the bags towards the wall shown below (NOT THE GATE).

  1. Once all the bags are in front of the wall, start throwing them over to the van like shown below.

  1. To jump over the fences like shown below, you must sprint towards the wall and spam jump while facing forward.

docs.title: Sweepot
docs.text:
Sweepot is featured on all 3 versions of SSD

  1. At the beginning, mask up, run forward, turn back, boost your teammates, run towards the corner, and use your molotov at the middle of the warehouse entrance.

  1. As you are running towards the water tank on a fork lift, first slide at the spot shown in the picture and then start holding down your ECM at the spot again shown in the picture.

  1. As you enter Transport (Warehouse) first kill the guard and grab your key. Second loot the "Weapon Loot on Barrels" if it spawned. Leave the Transport through the front right garage door.

Tip: If the "Weapon Loot" is spawned check around for your second and third key while interacting with looting it.

  1. As you leave Transport (Warehouse) , turn around by the Staircase and kill the guard which has your Second Key.

This guard could also spawn at the docks like shown in this second picture.

  1. Your third key will be on this guard which roams around the (Far Docks & Goose). He will spawn in the circles shown below. He can roam in the whole line shown below.

  1. Timing of your second ECM placement is shown in the picture below, when you start holding down your ECM at the point below you will have your ECM placed right in front of the first garage door.

  1. Proceed with opening your garages right to left. During this process follow the path of line and use the yellow points as where to stay for faster door opening.

Why yellow points? There's a delay between door swap's. You can stand on the yellow point and start moving to the left side (pressing A while facing the garage doors) as the interaction is around 80%.

This way you'll end up on the second door without losing your time on door swap delay because you started moving towards the left side as your interaction closes to an end.

  1. As you are looting your garages, throw the loot towards the blue burlap corner.

Make sure to juggle the bags thrown in your path by R4!

  1. Throw the bags in the corner to escape over Blue Burlap like shown below.

  1. After you are done with throwing all the bags over to escape, use the street light skip for middle warehouse access like shown below.

  1. Before making your way to the Middle Warehouse, make sure to check the corner crate RNG and loot it if R4 has not yet.

Spawns (RNG)

docs.title: Diamond Store (DS)
docs.text:
Video tutorial

Diamond Store is featured on the “Booster or gamepass” and “Booster and gamepass” versions of SSD.

  1. Enter the store and break your designated glass cases using a molly or a grenade launcher (see the image).
  2. Bag the two jewels, the furthest first, then the closest.
  3. Exit the store, throw your bags to the escape zone and go into it (you can jump and throw your bags while running from the spot shown in the image).

docs.title: Nightclub (NC)
docs.text:
Nightclub is featured on the “Booster/Gamepass” and “Booster and Gamepass” versions of SSD.

IMPORTANT: first nightclub will be full sweep, meaning you grab whatever is in the safe (you grab cola or jewelry if not cash)

  1. Enter the building, either through the front entrance or jumping onto the balcony using the Coach Gun.

  1. Run past the dance floor and into the back area, then enter the basement and open the safe (route shown below).

  1. Two Variants:

    1. If there is cash in the safe, use the “Yes!” callout, then bag the middle cash stack and the left cash stack, if no one has reached your safe yet by the time you finish bagging both cash stacks, then throw them near the stairs for them to pick up and bag the remaining stack.

    2. If there isn’t cash in your safe, read the chat to see who called out “Yes!”; if r1 called it, then go to their safe (manager’s office), if r3 called it and r1 didn’t, then go to r3’s safe (poker room). Bag a cash stack from the safe, if you got there late then grab the bags they threw instead.

  2. Bring your bags to the van, throw them in, and step inside to escape.

Good luck on your application!

It’s heavily recommended that you try practicing your pathing for each heist before doing your first rotation, as well as learning the map layouts if you are very new to the game. If you have any questions you can ask in the help channel in the Discord server.

docs.title: Shadow Raid (SR)
docs.text:
Shadow Raid is featured on the “No Gamepass, No Booster” and “Booster/Gamepass” versions of SSD.

  1. Mask up, charisma your teammates, then molly yourself for second wind while following the red path

  1. After going upstairs, place your sentry at the yellow circle, and check inside the cages. If there is loot inside, open them and grab the loot. Then kick open the door to the camera room to check if the cam operator has a keycard, your sentry should kill him

docs.title: Sweepot
docs.text:
Sweepot is featured on all 3 versions of SSD. You will be ECMing at 0:50, 1:10

  1. Mask up, sprint, charisma your teammates and follow the red path (yellow line shows alternative, advanced path using coach/sonaz gun)

  1. After entering the transport building, you will be looking for various key spawns. You will grab two keys. Key spawns (circled in red) are shown in the pictures below:

Note

remembering all of these key spawns can be pretty difficult, it’s highly recommended that you practice key finding pathing until you develop consistency. You will also loot key spawns in that order

If you grab your two ground keys before finish key find pathing, you can then stop searching for keys)

Also look out for potential loot spawns (loot you will grab will be circled in green)

  1. After finishing looting downstairs, make your way upstairs and kill the upstairs guard. Go to upstairs key spawns if required.

Tip

Look out for the exclamation marks on top of the guard. This can help you pinpoint the exact location of the guard. The guard also has a chance to go outside through upstairs or downstairs (Blue path shows potential guard pathing)

  1. After looting all your keys and loot spawns, you will exit transport and make your way to 3g. Make sure to constantly slide and maintain sw uptake when moving distances.

(Alternative, faster route shown by yellow line) If you’re upstairs, you can also take this path:

  1. At 3g, you will start by opening the garage from right to left, then loot from left to right, shown by the red path.

After looting those garages, follow the green path, loot the last garage and proceed to move bags

Note

It is important to keep track of the timer to know when you will ECM. Typically at 3g, you will place your first ECM then, at 50s, so be aware of that

  1. Move the bags towards the fence, and throw the bags over the fence and onto the slope, shown in the picture below. Make sure that no bags fall into the green zone as it can really screw your bag moving.

  1. Finally, move the bags towards the red circle, then into the escape zone. Once finished, if r3 is still moving their bags, help them move their bags towards escape.

  1. Enter the nightclub through the main entrance and navigate to the poker room

CashCola/Jewlery

Full SweepMinimum

Ignore the safe contents and proceed

Callout

docs.title: Shadow Raid (SR)
docs.text:
1. Enter the warehouse through the right entrance and place a sentry to the left of the entrance

    Warning

    The sentry must not have line of sight outside

  2. Check the office to bag the cash

  3. Take the crowbar from the storage room and bag the cash

  4. Bag the cola in the locker room

  5. Loot the weapons on the large box, place your 2nd sentry in this area

  6. Loot all crates and grab the gold bar in the main warehouse section in a clockwise direction

  7. Loot this red container if it has not been looted already

  8. Secure the bags into the van

    Info

    r3 is responsible for the 2nd position from the front of the bag moving chain. This will usually be from the red container to the wall.

    if bags are not thrown directly into the van from the wall, the 1st position may jump over to secure those bags, moving your 2nd position forward to the wall.

docs.title: Sweepot
docs.text:
Role 3 is responsible for looting most of the crates on the map.

Ecm

at 1:30 and 1:50 on the timer

  1. Follow this path until you find a crowbar

    Info

    most of the time you find a crowbar in the first 5 spots but the following path has been prepared in case of a theoretical worst case scenario

  2. Loot all of the crates in the spawn warehouse and throw any bags towards the 3 garages

  3. In the transport building, loot all crates, bag the cash under the stairs, cola and weapon on the barrel

  4. Throw all your bags and any bag left behind by r2 in front of the middle warehouse and loot the crate by the truck

  5. Loot the crate under the middle crane

    Note

    If you brought a Jack of All Trades sentry, place it in this area

  6. Loot all crates and bag the weapons in middle warehouse

  7. Move all bags towards escape and loot the crate under escape crane
